findings: Announcements: archive and hide are indistinguishable — AnnouncementsArchivePage filters on !a.is_active, which captures items toggled hidden via the Hide button as well as items archived from the detail pane. Add a separate is_archived boolean column, or remove the Archive action from the detail pane and treat Hide as the only archival mechanism.

AccountsPage: dual entry points produce different UIs for the same state — userListFilter === 'archived' can be reached from both the page header button (replaces split-pane with AccountsArchivePage) and the Active/Archived pill inside the left pane (filters list but leaves right pane visible). Remove the Archived option from the left-pane pill filter, or separate into independent state variables.

SystemAppsManager: Status dropdown is a hidden second entry point — the toolbar Status dropdown includes Archived and writes statusFilter = 'archived', triggering the archive view, but is then invisible in that view and exits only via the Archive button's Back label. Remove Archived from the Status dropdown and rely solely on the Archive header button.
